relationships.explanation: Carves out an exception to the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change.

extractions.unit: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.logic_text: any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5
unit_attributes.summary: A material discrepancy is defined as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

extractions.unit: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

unit_attributes.logic_text: between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity

unit_attributes.summary: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of citizenship/non-citizen nationality and identity.

extractions.unit: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

alternative_quotes: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
unit_attributes.choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees ((a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section

unit_attributes.summary: Material discrepancies between the application name and citizenship/nationality or identity evidence must be documented by submitting one or more listed acceptable documents, subject to the exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

alternative_quotes: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
unit_attributes.choice_text: Acceptable means include: (1) Court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.object_quote: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change
unit_attributes.object: acceptable means of documenting a material name change
unit_attributes.summary: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees), certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage.

extractions.unit: NOTE: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

unit_attributes.action: be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
unit_attributes.summary: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration.

extractions.unit: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change

unit_attributes.summary: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change.

extractions.unit: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

unit_attributes.action: specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
unit_attributes.summary: An applicant is excepted from the ban on continuing to use a previous name after a material name change if the name change documentation specifically permits continuing to use that name.

extractions.unit: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:

unit_attributes.action: be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
unit_attributes.summary: Evidence of identity might be required under 22 CFR 51.23(c) in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.

extractions.unit: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change

unit_attributes.action: suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name
unit_attributes.summary: If an applicant had a material name change over one year prior to applying on form DS-11 without updating their ID, the application must be suspended to request acceptable ID in the new name.

extractions.unit: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

unit_attributes.action: be issued in the requested name
unit_attributes.summary: A limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name if there is insufficient time prior to urgent or emergency travel to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID.

extractions.unit: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.action: need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID
unit_attributes.summary: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on their ID.

extractions.unit: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

unit_attributes.summary: Personnel must fully notate the name change documentation (including that it was 'seen and returned') prior to returning it to the applicant with an information request letter (IRL).
